caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a cropped jacket featuring long sleeves and a v-shaped neckline. The jacket appears to be made of a light-colored fabric, predominantly a pale grayish or off-white hue with subtle shading that gives the illustration a three-dimensional appearance. Decorative ruffled trim lines the neckline, hem, sleeve cuffs, and runs horizontally across the upper arms and bodice. The jacket has full-length sleeves with additional ruffled bands near the wrists. The background is plain and light, allowing the details and color variations in the jacket to stand out. The drawing is rendered with fine, precise lines and soft shading, and a small, red signature is present near the lower right corner of the composition.
title: Embroidered Bolero Jacket
